# MY Tourism

> Premium travel agency and luxury chauffeur transfer provider in Dubai and across the United Arab Emirates.

## Services & Offerings
- [Dubai Desert Safari](https://mytourism.ae/#desert-safari): VIP Red Dune Bashing, Quad Biking, Camel Riding, and BBQ Dinner.
- [Full Day Abu Dhabi Tour](https://mytourism.ae/#city-tours): Guided private sightseeing tours from Dubai to Abu Dhabi.
- [Dubai City Tour](https://mytourism.ae/#city-tours): Private transfers covering Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Marina, and historical landmarks.
- [Luxury Fleet Rentals](https://mytourism.ae/#fleet): Executive chauffeur services featuring Lexus 300H, BMW 7 Series, Mercedes S-Class/V-Class, GMC Yukon XL, and passenger buses (22, 35, and 50 seaters).
- [Monthly Car Lift & Airport Transfers](https://mytourism.ae/#fleet): 24/7 DXB airport pickups and inter-emirate monthly transfers between Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.
